question: A $6\,\mu\text{F}$ capacitor and a $12\,\mu\text{F}$ capacitor are connected separately first in series and then in parallel. Compare the equivalent capacitances in the two cases. If each combination is connected across the same $18\text{ V}$ battery, calculate the total charge stored in each combination and justify the difference.

options.A: $C_s=4\,\mu\text{F}$, $C_p=18\,\mu\text{F}$; at $18\,\text{V}$, $Q_s=72\,\mu\text{C}$ and $Q_p=324\,\mu\text{C}$. Parallel has larger charge because its equivalent capacitance is larger.
options.C: $C_s=4\,\mu\text{F}$, $C_p=18\,\mu\text{F}$; both combinations store $72\,\mu\text{C}$ because the same battery is used.
